title: More text models, plus a new way to make video
summary:
New text and video models arrived while community apps gave generated images more places to live.

GPT-OSS 20B joined the text lineup as `gpt-oss`, with reasoning and tool calls. Six more text models were added through OpenRouter: Kimi K3, Grok 4.5, Gemma 4 31B, MiMo V2.5, MiMo V2.5 Pro, and Qwen3.7 Max. `qwen-large` moved to OpenRouter with updated context settings and a reasoning toggle. The paid-only `happyhorse-1.1` model adds 720p video generation from text or a first-frame image, with seven aspect ratios and durations from 3 to 15 seconds.

CatGPT added a public meme gallery, including images from its Discord bot. AI Dungeon Master now saves generated images to its public gallery. Product Packaging Designer, Virtual Makeup, SlidePainter, and the opposite-prompt Discord bot also began publishing generated images to tagged media storage; generation and replies still work if publishing fails.

OpenAI-compatible image generation and edit responses now report input, output, and total token usage, with image and text input broken out. The model catalog now correctly describes Stable Audio 3 reference-audio support and `gemini-fast` audio input; `stable-audio-3` also resolves to the Large model. On mobile, the model list keeps its card layout in landscape and expanded cards show copyable model slugs.
